top.reason: detach() calls emitter.off with a new bind(this) closure, not the listener reference passed to on(), so the original listener is never removed and continues forwarding to the disposed handler.

take() reads bucket state, awaits store.set later without locking, so two concurrent requests for the same clientId can both read the same token count and both pass the tokens<1 check, allowing more requests through than capacity permits.
Comparator returns a boolean instead of a numeric difference, so Array.sort does not reliably sort by publishedAt descending (or ascending), producing an incorrectly ordered feed.
`for...in` yields string keys, so `index + 1` string-concatenates instead of adding numerically (e.g. '0'+1='01'), producing non-numeric rank values contrary to the documented 1-based numeric rank.
await this.client.ping() has no try/catch, so a failed ping rejects unhandled and never sets healthy=false, contradicting the documented requirement that a failed ping mark the connection unhealthy.
lastN slices from visits.length - n - 1 instead of visits.length - n, returning n+1 elements (or all when n>=length) instead of the documented n most recent visits.
forEach with async callback is fire-and-forget, but the docstring explicitly states delivery is deliberately not awaited and failures are only logged, matching this behavior exactly.
Per-account queue chaining serializes consume calls correctly, preventing lost updates across concurrent calls for the same account.
daysBetween and countDays are consistent with the documented inclusive range semantics for numeric day values; no observable defect shown.
All three sort comparators are correct and Array.prototype.sort is stable in modern JS engines, so byScore's tie-order claim holds.

Each interval tick starts a new fetch without checking if a prior fetch is still pending, so overlapping async responses can resolve out of order and let a stale result overwrite a newer 'latest'/'failures' state.
Optional address and theme fields are safely handled with nullish coalescing defaults; no defect is demonstrated in the shown code.
